summary: Comprehensive testing of Intelligence Loop (Cold Start Protocol) and Social Binder features. Fixed 1 critical bug in public_binder endpoint. All 18 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working correctly.

bugs_fixed.issue: TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got _asyncio.Future
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed `async for pull in db.case_pulls.find(...).to_list(500)` to `pulls_raw = await cursor.to_list(500)` followed by regular for loop

critical_code_review_comments: Intelligence Loop confidence tiers working correctly - Tier 1 (Market Only) returns market_weight=1.0, pull_weight=0.0
pack_cost_source correctly returns 'msrp_fallback' when eBay is blocked (expected behavior in preview pod)
Privacy rule enforced: GET /api/binders/public/{user_id} strips case_pack_id, pack_type_id from pulls, sets source_pack='—'
Visibility toggle PATCH /api/case/packs/{id}/visibility works correctly - owner can toggle, non-owner gets 403
Thumbs voting logic correct: self-voting blocked (400), voting on private binder blocked (403), toggle/switch works
New user registration correctly gets 10-day trial (tier='pro')
Brand rename to 'Rip N' Flip' visible throughout app
seed_data_creation: Test binders and pulls created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Intelligence Loop and Social Binder features tested and working: (1) GET /api/analyzer/{pack_id} returns verdict with intelligence block containing confidence.{label,tier,market_weight,pull_weight} + pack_cost_source field. (2) PATCH /api/case/packs/{id}/visibility toggles is_public, non-owner gets 403. (3) GET /api/binders/public lists public binders aggregated by user. (4) GET /api/binders/public/{user_id} returns pulls with source_pack='—' (privacy enforced). (5) POST /api/case/pulls/{pull_id}/thumbs handles voting with self-vote block (400), private binder block (403), toggle/switch logic. (6) Frontend: Landing page shows 'WHAT SHOULD I RIP TODAY?' with green ANALYZE button. Navbar shows 'RIP N' FLIP' logo with GALLERY link. Analyzer shows ConfidenceBadge + IntelligencePanel. DisplayCase has PUBLIC/PRIVATE toggle. PublicGallery and PublicBinder pages work with solitaire spread.

intelligence_loop.notes: Verdict includes intelligence block with confidence tiers. Tier 1 (0-49 pulls) = Market Only, 100% market weight. pack_cost_source correctly shows 'msrp_fallback' when eBay blocked.

visibility_toggle.notes: Owner can toggle is_public. Non-owner gets 403. UI toggle works in DisplayCase.

public_binders.notes: List aggregates by user. Individual binder strips source pack info (privacy rule). source_pack='—' on all pulls.

thumbs_voting.notes: Self-voting blocked (400). Voting on private binder blocked (403). Toggle same vote removes it. Switch vote updates count. Only thumbs_up_count tracked publicly.

trial_logic.notes: New user gets tier='pro' with trial_days_left > 0. _user_tier function fixed and working.

brand_rename.notes: App renamed to 'Rip N' Flip' throughout. Logo shows green tile + cyan N' + pink FLIP. Footer shows '© 2026 Rip N' Flip · Rip. Chase. Flip. Repeat.'

frontend_ui.notes: All pages load correctly. ConfidenceBadge shows 4 dots (filled based on tier). IntelligencePanel shows progress bar + stats. Solitaire spread works. Visibility toggle works.
